active.name: MYSQL_DSN
active.validation: 仅TCP，同库名；非root最小DML；TLS验证CA和主机名；拒绝skip-verify、preferred及multiStatements
active.missing_behavior: 使用该键的进程遇缺失、空白或非法值必须启动失败且非零退出；不得打印值
active.timeout: 连接/读/写各3000ms；业务数据库总预算5000ms，从传输校验后首次DB操作开始，重试不重置

active.name: MYSQL_MIGRATION_DSN
active.validation: 离线最小DDL账号；与MYSQL_DSN同TCP目标、库名和证书验证；仅工具连接可启用multiStatements，服务进程不读取
active.missing_behavior: 使用该键的进程遇缺失、空白或非法值必须启动失败且非零退出；不得打印值
active.timeout: 连接3000ms；迁移/初始化锁10000ms；单条DDL30000ms，失败dirty且非零

active.name: MYSQL_CA_FILE
active.validation: 只读CA文件，验证服务端证书链和主机名；不可读/无效即失败
active.missing_behavior: 使用该键的进程遇缺失、空白或非法值必须启动失败且非零退出；不得打印值
active.timeout: 启动检查；连接继承对应DSN预算

active.name: AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGIN
active.validation: 单个精确HTTPS origin，不含用户信息/路径/查询/片段，不允许null或通配；运行时Origin匹配失败403
active.missing_behavior: 使用该键的进程遇缺失、空白或非法值必须启动失败且非零退出；不得打印值
active.timeout: 启动检查；请求中按凭据优先顺序判定

active.name: AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
active.validation: 有限代理对等端CIDR，拒绝IPv4/IPv6的/0及空项；Nginx覆写单一X-Real-IP，仅信任登记对等端提供的合法单一IP；否则用直连源
active.missing_behavior: 使用该键的进程遇缺失、空白或非法值必须启动失败且非零退出；不得打印值
active.timeout: 启动检查；不发起网络查询

active.name: HTTPS_CERT_FILE
active.validation: 只读证书链，SAN匹配可信origin主机；客户端必须信任且证书有效
active.missing_behavior: 使用该键的进程遇缺失、空白或非法值必须启动失败且非零退出；不得打印值
active.timeout: Nginx启动检查；缺失/无效不启动

active.name: HTTPS_KEY_FILE
active.validation: 只读最小权限私钥，与证书匹配；不进入Git/镜像/日志，不自动生成
active.missing_behavior: 使用该键的进程遇缺失、空白或非法值必须启动失败且非零退出；不得打印值
active.timeout: Nginx启动检查；缺失/无效不启动

active.name: IDENTITY_STATE_DIR
active.validation: Absolute existing local directory containing operator-owned files; never a build context

active.name: IDENTITY_PROXY_NETWORK
active.validation: Existing dedicated internal Docker bridge; do not reuse unrelated networks

active.name: IDENTITY_PROXY_IP
active.validation: Available IPv4 on that bridge, assigned only to gateway; backend trusts this exact /32

active.name: IDENTITY_HTTPS_HOST
active.validation: DNS hostname matching certificate SAN and trusted origin; no port or Nginx syntax

active.name: IDENTITY_HTTPS_PORT
active.validation: Host loopback port 1..65535; verifier alone may use 0 for Docker allocated port

constraints: 解析目标为本项目网络服务
outbound_exceptions.removal: 不再使用受控MCP服务时移除
